```{=html}
<style>
/* Scoped under .flyer so it can't disturb the Quarto theme. */
.flyer, .flyer * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.flyer {
  --navy: #00205B;
  --gold: #b8912f;
  --ink:  #1a1a1a;
  --gray: #444;
  --mut:  #6b6b6b;
  --line: #e4e4e4;
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 8px 0 24px;
}

.flyer .sheet {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px 8px 8px;
  background: transparent;
}

/* ---- Masthead ---------------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .eyebrow {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.flyer .display {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 48px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.flyer .meta-inline {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px 18px;
}
.flyer .meta-inline span { font-size: 18px; color: #333; }
.flyer .meta-inline .dot { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }

.flyer .subline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #555;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.flyer .subline b { color: var(--ink); }

.flyer .rule {
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 26px 0 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 62%, var(--gold) 62% 100%);
}

/* ---- Week headings ----------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: 20px 0 10px;
}
.flyer .section-head .label,
.flyer .section-head .dates {
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ---- Session rows ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Three columns: date chip | title and description | download links.
   The chip is a plain label. Downloads are named links at the right of the
   row, so they are visible without hovering and work on touch. */

.flyer .item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.flyer .chip {
  flex: 0 0 140px;
  background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 7px 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: block;
}
.flyer .chip .chip-time {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* A day with no session: muted. Its chip carries an empty chip-time so it
   matches the height of the real chips without hardcoding a number. */
.flyer .chip-off {
  background: #e7e9ee;
  color: var(--mut);
}

/* flex-basis 0 so the text shrinks to share the row rather than wrapping
   below the chip once .item is allowed to wrap on narrow screens. */
.flyer .item-body {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.flyer .item-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
}
/* Must follow .item-title: same specificity, so source order decides. */
.flyer .item-title-off { color: var(--mut); }
.flyer .item-desc {
  font-size: 15.5px;
  color: var(--gray);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* padding-top drops the links level with the chip's second line (the time)
   rather than its first, so they sit lower than the session title. */
.flyer .item-links {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-top: 25px;
}
.flyer .item-links a {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.flyer .item-links a:hover,
.flyer .item-links a:focus { text-decoration: underline; }
.flyer .item-links a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.flyer .item-links .sep {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 7px;
}

/* The links are right-aligned, so a row with no Files download would pull its
   Slides link further right than its neighbours'. A phantom copy of the dot and
   the word reserves that width without showing it, keeping every Slides link on
   one vertical line. visibility:hidden (not display:none) is what holds the
   box open, and it also takes the text out of the accessibility tree and out of
   tab order, so there is nothing to click or hear. Must match the font of the
   real links or it reserves the wrong width. */
.flyer .item-links .phantom {
  visibility: hidden;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* "Slides" links straight to the HTML deck, and hovering it offers the choice
   of HTML or PDF. Touch devices have no hover, so a tap just follows the link
   to the HTML deck, which is the sensible default. */
.flyer .has-menu {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}
/* No overflow:hidden here -- it would clip the ::before bridge below, which is
   what lets the pointer cross the gap. The corners are rounded on the child
   links instead. Hiding is delayed so a brief slip off the menu does not
   close it before it can be clicked; showing stays instant. */
.flyer .has-menu .submenu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 20;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.12s 0.4s, visibility 0s 0.52s;
}
/* Spans the gap, with slack either side for an imprecise pointer. */
.flyer .has-menu .submenu::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -10px;
  left: -12px;
  width: calc(100% + 24px);
  height: 10px;
}
.flyer .has-menu:hover .submenu,
.flyer .has-menu:focus-within .submenu {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition: opacity 0.12s 0s, visibility 0s 0s;
}
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a {
  display: block;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:first-child { border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:last-child  { border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a + a { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:hover,
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:focus {
  background: #eef1f6;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* ---- Footer ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.flyer .sheet-foot {
  margin-top: 28px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot .url  { font-size: 20px; }
.flyer .sheet-foot .zoom { font-size: 17px; }

/* ---- Narrow screens ---------------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .flyer .display { font-size: 33px; }
  .flyer .chip { flex-basis: 108px; font-size: 12px; }
  .flyer .chip .chip-time { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .flyer .item-title { font-size: 17px; }

  /* Too narrow for a third column, so the links wrap onto their own line,
     indented to line up with the session title above them. */
  .flyer .item { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .flyer .item-links {
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-left: 124px;
    padding-top: 5px;
  }
  .flyer .item-links a { font-size: 14px; }
}
</style>

<!-- To post a session's material, add an item-links div to that row. Copy the
     Aug 10 row below and swap the three paths: the deck's .html twice (the
     Slides link itself and the HTML entry), its .pdf, and the session zip.

     Keep that div's contents on one line: the links are inline, so a line
     break between them would show up as an extra space around the dot.
     Paths are relative to docs/, e.g. slides/2_working.html. Anything
     linked must also be listed under resources: in _quarto.yml.

     If a session has no PDF, drop the has-menu and submenu spans and leave
     a plain <a href="PATH" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Slides</a>.

     If a session has no Files zip, keep the phantom spans the Aug 12 row uses
     in place of the real dot and link. They are invisible but hold the width
     open, so that row's Slides link stays in line with the others'. Drop them
     when a real Files link is added.

     Every link here opens in a new tab, so keep the target and rel on any
     you add.                                                              -->
```
